pages.text: Momo has a red hat. She loves her red hat.
One day, the wind blows. Oh no! The hat flies away.
Momo looks under the tree. No hat.

“Rabbit, do you see my red hat?”
“No,” says Rabbit.

“Bear, do you see my red hat?”
“No,” says Bear.

“Duck, do you see my red hat?”
“No,” says Duck.
Momo is sad. Where is her red hat?
Look! A bird has the red hat. It is a nest!
Momo sees the baby birds in the hat. They are warm.
“You can have my hat,” says Momo. The birds sing.
Mama knits a new hat for Momo. It is red, too!
